mapper.select: SELECT id, aggregate_id as aggregateId, event_type as eventType, payload, status, retry_count as retryCount, last_attempt_at as lastAttemptAt, created_at as createdAt FROM outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox SET status = #{status}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, last_attempt_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT event_id as eventId, event_type as eventType, payload, status, error_log as errorLog, processed_at as processedAt, received_at as receivedAt FROM inbox WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.update: UPDATE inbox SET status = #{status}, error_log = #{errorLog}, processed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'PROCESSED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
